senses.sense_definition: Anything in an intermediate position, often referring to a student at a middle level of proficiency.

senses.sense_definition: Any substance formed as part of a series of chemical reactions that is not the end-product.

target_lang_translations.pl: Podczas eksperymentu naukowiec wyizolował stabilny <w>produkt pośredni</w>.
